title: Hitchhiking Across China: Thumbs Up Season 3 (Part 4/5)
summary: Part Four begins in Zhengzhou with graphic motorbike jokes, Harry's alienation as interpreted by David, and a map dispute that ends with Stephanie choosing the coast while David repeatedly predicts regret and chooses Harry. Her objections and choice remain authoritative despite the pressure. David then sexualizes her after departure, offers a gendered road metaphor and unsupported hitchhiking-assault statistics, and reports the crew slept on an unidentified roof. The Yangtze plan and launch retain warnings about barges, capacity and danger. On the river, the crew chases geese, apologizes in untranslated Mandarin and proposes exchanging its small craft for a larger-boat ride; agreement and ownership cannot be assumed. After arriving near Wuhan, Harry disappears and a private caller leads the crew to a supposed love hotel. David's final recap alleges Sheeka, a pimp, burned women, a US$1,000 fight and Harry's victory. None is independently established by the transcript or direct participant testimony. The entire account stays literal but is barred from trafficking, abuse, criminal or rescue metadata. No explicit publisher speaker prefixes occur anywhere in the caption text.
